hypotheses.I0_saved_factor_recomposition_is_exact: Saved CE factors recompose prediction-minus-target to relative error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.I1_identity_residual_improves_validation: The shared identity-plus-residual map improves mean validation write fidelity by at least 0.10 over the fitted scaled identity.
hypotheses.I2_identity_residual_predicts_behavior: The selected map retains at least 0.80 of prediction, target, and margin behavioral effects on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.I3_identity_residual_explains_model_marg: The selected map retains at least 0.80 of model-margin behavioral effects on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.I4_shared_residual_matches_component_spe: Shared-map behavioral fidelity is within 0.05 of separately selected component-specific residual maps for every component and corpus.
hypotheses.I5_identity_residual_is_rank512_or_small: Validation selects a residual rank of at most 512.
hypotheses.I6_identity_residual_transfers_ood: For each component, WikiText and TinyStories behavioral fidelity are within 0.10 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.I7_identity_residual_avoids_behavioral_s: Selected shared behavioral fidelity is nonnegative for CE, prediction, target, and margin on every corpus.
